explanation: The king of Judea who persecuted the first Christians and had James, son of Zebedee, executed.
The apostle who was killed with a sword during Herod's reign.
The apostle who was imprisoned by Herod but saved from death by an angel.
A heavenly being sent by God to free Peter from prison during the night.
The place where Peter was locked in chains between two soldiers under guard.
The bonds that held Peter bound, but which were loosened when the angel came to him.
The gathered group of believers who prayed earnestly for God to save Peter from prison.
The son of Queen Herodias and later king, who was also an enemy of the Christians.
The fate of Herod, who was bitten by worms because he did not give glory to God for his power.
The insects or worms that attacked Herod according to the text and led to his death.
